text:
### Mission  
Provide secure, scalable, reliable technology infrastructure and systems.
name: Chunk 61/102

raw_entities.name: Technology Infrastructure and Systems
raw_entities.description: The business unit responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and reliable technology infrastructure and systems across FirstUK Bank. This unit provides the foundational technology platform upon which all banking operations and customer-facing services depend.
context: Provide secure, scalable, reliable technology infrastructure and systems

raw_entities.name: Technology Infrastructure
raw_entities.description: The foundational technology systems and infrastructure that support FirstUK Bank's operations. Characterized by requirements for security, scalability, and reliability to underpin all banking services.
context: Provide secure, scalable, reliable technology infrastructure and systems

raw_entities.name: Technology Security Requirement
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that all technology infrastructure and systems operated by FirstUK Bank must be secure. This is a foundational control ensuring protection of customer data and banking operations.
context: Provide secure, scalable, reliable technology infrastructure and systems

raw_entities.name: Technology Scalability Requirement
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that all technology infrastructure and systems must be scalable to support growth and changing business demands. This ensures the bank can expand capacity without fundamental redesign.
context: Provide secure, scalable, reliable technology infrastructure and systems

raw_entities.name: Technology Reliability Requirement
raw_entities.description: A mandatory requirement that all technology infrastructure and systems must be reliable to ensure continuous availability of banking services. This supports the bank's operational continuity and customer service commitments.
context: Provide secure, scalable, reliable technology infrastructure and systems
